query:
WITH revoked AS (
            UPDATE refresh_tokens
            SET revoked_at = now()
            WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND family_id = $3 AND revoked_at IS NULL
            RETURNING id
          )
          SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM refresh_tokens
            WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND family_id = $3
          ) AS "owned!"
